question: Who among the following has been appointed as the Chairman of the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) in May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GR Chintala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **GR Chintala** has been appointed as the Chairman of the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) in May 2020.
 
• He replaces **DPK Gunasekera.**
 
• **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)** is an apex development finance institution fully owned by the Government of India.
 
• The bank has been entrusted with** "matters concerning policy, planning, and operations in the field of credit for agriculture and other economic activities in rural areas in India".**
 
 
• **Headquarters**:- Mumbai.
 
• **Chairman:** Govinda Rajulu Chintala.
 
• **Foundation-**: 12 July 1982.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• ​NABARD is a development bank concentrating principally on the rural sector of the country. 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) at the demand of the Government of India, constituted a Committee to Review the Arrangements For Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development (CRAFICARD) in 1979, under the Chairmanship of Shri B. Sivaraman, a former member of Planning Commission. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **
